title: BECE Business Studies: Office Practice - Business Studies - Office Staff
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An employee who performs routine administrative and record-keeping duties in an office is referred to as a
questions.explain: A **clerical staff** (or clerk) is an office worker employed to manage routine administrative tasks, keep records, and handle correspondence.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The following are routine functions of a clerical staff EXCEPT
questions.explain: While clerks handle daily routines like filing, sorting mail, and answering calls, **making overall company policy decisions** is the function of top-level management or the board of directors.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following duties is predominantly performed by a clerk in the general office?
questions.explain: A major part of a general clerk's function is handling correspondence, which includes receiving incoming mail and **dispatching outgoing letters and parcels**. Auditing, firing, and contract-signing are specialized or managerial tasks.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The ability of a clerical staff to politely and effectively communicate with colleagues and visitors demonstrates good
questions.explain: Interacting politely, calmly, and respectfully with others in the workplace falls under the quality of **good human relations**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All the following are desirable personal qualities of a good clerical staff EXCEPT
questions.explain: A clerk must be punctual, honest, and neat. **Rudeness** is a negative trait that ruins interpersonal relationships and reflects poorly on the organization.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The ethical practice of keeping official information and trade secrets safe from unauthorized persons is known as
questions.explain: **Confidentiality** is the ethical and professional duty of an office worker not to disclose sensitive or private information about the organization to outsiders or unauthorized staff.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A clerical worker who leaks a company's sensitive financial data to a rival firm lacks the quality of
questions.explain: Sharing private organizational information with a competitor is a direct violation of trust and demonstrates a lack of **confidentiality**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A clerical staff who is specifically in charge of receiving, keeping records of, and issuing out physical goods in an organization is the
questions.explain: A **store clerk** (or storekeeper) handles the specific clerical function of managing inventory, recording incoming goods, and issuing materials to various departments.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: To handle office machines and stationery without causing unnecessary waste or damage, a clerical staff must possess the quality of
questions.explain: Working with organizational assets such as photocopiers, computers, and paper requires **carefulness** to prevent waste, damage, and unnecessary financial loss to the company.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In a small office, Mr. Bello prepares letters, types documents, operates the photocopier, and files records. Mr. Bello is acting as a
questions.explain: Typing, photocopying, filing, and preparing correspondence are typical day-to-day duties assigned to a **clerical staff**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Why is confidentiality of office information strictly required from every office staff?
options: To ensure that junior staff are afraid of their managers
To protect the organization from fraud and loss of competitive advantage
To allow competitors to easily copy the business model
To deliberately make the daily work of a clerk more difficult
questions.explain: Confidentiality protects the business's trade secrets, customer data, and financial plans. Leaking this could lead to **fraud, loss of clients, and loss of competitive advantage** against rivals.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A good clerical staff should demonstrate a high level of accuracy. This means the staff must
options: complete tasks efficiently without making mistakes
type at exactly 120 words per minute
dress in very expensive designer clothes daily
arrive at the office before the sun rises
questions.explain: Accuracy in clerical work means being precise, attentive to detail, and able to **complete tasks (like data entry or calculation) without making mistakes**.
questions.subject: Business Studies
